### 12. Contract

This story publishes no operation and declares no table, no event, no workflow and no Schedule. The composed case-list read and export on the rwb-integration base are an additional, read-only composition outside rwb-access: GET /cases and GET /cases/export stay with rwb-case, and the case, ageing, parameter and access-log reads of that composition use the rwb-case and rwb-access contracts. The rule-package part of POST /authorise and its access-log decision code are fixed by RWB-P4-E1039-CON, whose contract fake registers them.
